Bombay High Court Halts BMC Takeover of YMCA Gymnasium

The Bombay High Court has issued a stay order against the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation's (BMC) attempt to take possession of the YMCA Gymnasium and playground located at Mumbai Central's Jhoola Maidan. The court's decision prevents the BMC from proceeding with its move to acquire the property.
